200.description: Starts a CLI login: a code for the person to approve at /device, and the device code the CLI polls with. Takes no fields; in particular no user, so a code is bound only to whoever approves it.

The CLI's poll. Once the code is approved, a Personal key ending 90 days after login, answered once; until then a 400 whose code is AUTHORIZATION_PENDING, SLOW_DOWN, EXPIRED_TOKEN, ACCESS_DENIED or INVALID_GRANT.
Who this request is made as: the email, the Organization it acts in, and the Personal key it carries (null for a console session). Answers only about the key the request was made with, never another.
The caller's own sessions. Deliberately carries no session token — the token is the credential, and revocation is by `id` (ADR-0009).
better-auth's member list. Note the envelope: the members are under `members`, not at the top level.
The draft-07 JSON Schema of a version 1 Project config
Every variable name the Application has, with the Output each wired one links to; never a value.
The variable names after the change, as GET answers them; never a value.
The deployment's log file, most recent `tail` lines last.

202.description: The Rollback is under way. `deploymentId` is the queued Deployment of a static site on AWS, whose log shows it; null on a Server, where Swarm converges the service onto the snapshot's image.

applicationId.description: The owning Application. Exactly one of applicationId, composeId or bucketId must be sent; a body carrying two is refused.

composeId.description: The owning Compose stack. Exactly one of applicationId, composeId or bucketId must be sent; a body carrying two is refused.

bucketId.description: The owning bucket on a Server, whose Garage S3 API the Domain routes to. Exactly one of applicationId, composeId or bucketId must be sent.

type.description: Must be 'file' when serviceType is 'compose'. Nothing assembles a Compose stack's mount rows into a deploy spec, so a bind or a volume attached to one would never be read; declare those in the stack's own compose file.

mountPath.description: Required unless serviceType is 'compose'. A compose stack's mount rows are never assembled into a deploy spec, so a compose mount has no container target to name; every other serviceType is refused without one.
